title: Mice problem
statementMd:
Igor the analyst fell asleep on the work and had a strange dream. In the dream his desk was crowded with computer mice, so he bought a mousetrap to catch them.

The desk can be considered as an infinite plane, then the mousetrap is a rectangle which sides are parallel to the axes, and which opposite sides are located in points $(*x*_{1}, *y*_{1})$ and $(*x*_{2}, *y*_{2})$.

Igor wants to catch all mice. Igor has analysed their behavior and discovered that each mouse is moving along a straight line with constant speed, the speed of the $*i*$-th mouse is equal to $(*v*_{*i*}^{*x*}, *v*_{*i*}^{*y*})$, that means that the $*x*$ coordinate of the mouse increases by $*v*_{*i*}^{*x*}$ units per second, while the $*y*$ coordinates increases by $*v*_{*i*}^{*y*}$ units. The mousetrap is open initially so that the mice are able to move freely on the desk. Igor can close the mousetrap at any moment catching all the mice that are **strictly** inside the mousetrap.

Igor works a lot, so he is busy in the dream as well, and he asks you to write a program that by given mousetrap's coordinates, the initial coordinates of the mice and their speeds determines the earliest time moment in which he is able to catch all the mice. Please note that Igor can close the mousetrap only once.

## Input

The first line contains single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$) — the number of computer mice on the desk.

The second line contains four integers $*x*_{1}$, $*y*_{1}$, $*x*_{2}$ and $*y*_{2}$ ($0 ≤ *x*_{1} ≤ *x*_{2} ≤ 100 000$), ($0 ≤ *y*_{1} ≤ *y*_{2} ≤ 100 000$) — the coordinates of the opposite corners of the mousetrap.

The next $*n*$ lines contain the information about mice.

The $*i*$-th of these lines contains four integers $*r*_{*i*}^{*x*}$, $*r*_{*i*}^{*y*}$, $*v*_{*i*}^{*x*}$ and $*v*_{*i*}^{*y*}$, ($0 ≤ *r*_{*i*}^{*x*}, *r*_{*i*}^{*y*} ≤ 100 000$, $- 100 000 ≤ *v*_{*i*}^{*x*}, *v*_{*i*}^{*y*} ≤ 100 000$), where $(*r*_{*i*}^{*x*}, *r*_{*i*}^{*y*})$ is the initial position of the mouse, and $(*v*_{*i*}^{*x*}, *v*_{*i*}^{*y*})$ is its speed.

## Output

In the only line print minimum possible non-negative number $*t*$ such that if Igor closes the mousetrap at $*t*$ seconds from the beginning, then all the mice are **strictly** inside the mousetrap. If there is no such $*t*$, print `-1`.

Your answer is considered correct if its absolute or relative error doesn't exceed $10^{ - 6}$.

Formally, let your answer be $*a*$, and the jury's answer be $*b*$. Your answer is considered correct if ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e34f390b7892522527fdc7497abba0c0c7784e31.png).

## Note

Here is a picture of the first sample

Points A, B, C, D - start mice positions, segments are their paths.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6a0b8b0786746f4d0bd24cde857f0bfb33d6638d.png)

Then, at first time when all mice will be in rectangle it will be looks like this:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c801dd4c22c893568d85350904f8ba3bf12e97e4.png)

Here is a picture of the second sample

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0bd5e231bae43659410f4f2af1078e56c08c729c.png)

Points A, D, B will never enter rectangle.
statementZhMd:
分析师 Igor 工作时睡着了，并做了一个奇怪的梦。在梦中，他的桌子上到处都是电脑老鼠，于是他买了一个捕鼠器来捕捉它们。

桌子可以看作一个无限平面，捕鼠器是一个边与坐标轴平行的矩形，其一对相对的顶点坐标为 $(*x*_{1}, *y*_{1})$ 和 $(*x*_{2}, *y*_{2})$。

Igor 想要捕捉所有老鼠。他分析了老鼠的行为，发现每只老鼠都沿直线以恒定速度移动。第 $*i*$ 只老鼠的速度为 $(*v*_{*i*}^{*x*}, *v*_{*i*}^{*y*})$，这意味着每秒老鼠的 $*x*$ 坐标增加 $*v*_{*i*}^{*x*}$ 个单位，而 $*y*$ 坐标增加 $*v*_{*i*}^{*y*}$ 个单位。捕鼠器最初处于打开状态，因此老鼠可以在桌面上自由移动。Igor 可以在任意时刻关闭捕鼠器，捕捉当时**严格**位于捕鼠器内部的所有老鼠。

Igor 工作十分繁忙，所以即使在梦中也很忙。他希望你编写一个程序，根据捕鼠器的坐标、老鼠的初始坐标和速度，确定他能够捕捉所有老鼠的最早时刻。请注意，Igor 只能关闭捕鼠器一次。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$）——桌面上电脑老鼠的数量。

第二行包含四个整数 $*x*_{1}$、$*y*_{1}$、$*x*_{2}$ 和 $*y*_{2}$（$0 ≤ *x*_{1} ≤ *x*_{2} ≤ 100 000$）、（$0 ≤ *y*_{1} ≤ *y*_{2} ≤ 100 000$）——捕鼠器一对相对顶点的坐标。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行包含老鼠的信息。

其中第 $*i*$ 行包含四个整数 $*r*_{*i*}^{*x*}$、$*r*_{*i*}^{*y*}$、$*v*_{*i*}^{*x*}$ 和 $*v*_{*i*}^{*y*}$（$0 ≤ *r*_{*i*}^{*x*}, *r*_{*i*}^{*y*} ≤ 100 000$，$- 100 000 ≤ *v*_{*i*}^{*x*}, *v*_{*i*}^{*y*} ≤ 100 000$），其中 $(*r*_{*i*}^{*x*}, *r*_{*i*}^{*y*})$ 是老鼠的初始位置，$(*v*_{*i*}^{*x*}, *v*_{*i*}^{*y*})$ 是它的速度。

## 输出格式

唯一一行输出最小的非负数 $*t*$，使得如果 Igor 从开始计时经过 $*t*$ 秒时关闭捕鼠器，则所有老鼠都**严格**位于捕鼠器内部。如果不存在这样的 $*t*$，输出 `-1`。

如果答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 6}$，则答案将被判定为正确。

形式化地，设你的答案为 $*a*$，评测程序的答案为 $*b*$。当且仅当 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e34f390b7892522527fdc7497abba0c0c7784e31.png) 时，你的答案被认为是正确的。

## 说明

下面是第一个样例的示意图。

点 A、B、C、D 表示老鼠的初始位置，线段表示它们的运动轨迹。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6a0b8b0786746f4d0bd24cde857f0bfb33d6638d.png)

然后，在所有老鼠都进入矩形后的最早时刻，情况如下图所示：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c801dd4c22c893568d85350904f8ba3bf12e97e4.png)

下面是第二个样例的示意图。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0bd5e231bae43659410f4f2af1078e56c08c729c.png)

点 A、D、B 永远不会进入矩形。
